item.name: Standard Black Headphones
item.howToGet: Head accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Standard black head-slot headphones that link to the phone Music app for private listening. A strong punch can knock them off, making the music audible to nearby players until you pick them up and put them back on.

item.name: Thinner Brown Headphones
item.howToGet: Head accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: A thinner brown headphone style with the same Music app private-listen use as the standard black pair. Knock-offs in combat also drop them and broadcast the track until re-equipped.

item.name: Thick Black Glasses
item.howToGet: Face accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Thick black frames for the face slot. In a fight, a hard hit can knock them off and blur your screen until you find them on the ground and re-equip them.

item.name: Thin Black Glasses
item.howToGet: Face accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Slimmer black frames with the same combat knock-off rule as the thick pair: lose them mid-fight and vision stays blurred until recovered.

item.name: Piercing
item.howToGet: Face accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: A subtle face piercing rolled in the face accessory pool. Looks only—no combat or phone effect.

item.name: Eye Patch
item.howToGet: Face accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: A worn-looking eye patch from the face accessory roll pool. Pure style customization with no gameplay effect.

item.name: Bandaid
item.howToGet: Face accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: A face-slot bandaid that suggests a minor injury look. Cosmetic only; no combat interaction.

item.name: Pink Scarf
item.howToGet: Neck accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Bright pink neck scarf for outfit layering. Rolled separately from other scarf colors; no combat or system bonus.

item.name: Black Scarf
item.howToGet: Neck accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Simple black neck scarf that pairs with most outfits. Cosmetic neck-slot item from accessory rolls.

item.name: Grey Scarf
item.howToGet: Neck accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Neutral grey scarf variant for low-key outfits. Neck accessory roll only; no gameplay effect.

item.name: Blue Scarf
item.howToGet: Neck accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Cool-toned blue scarf for the neck slot. One of four named scarf colors from accessory rolls.

item.name: Silver Cross Necklace
item.howToGet: Neck accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Silver cross necklace style for the neck slot. Cosmetic detail only—no combat or phone interaction.

item.name: Silver Key Necklace
item.howToGet: Neck accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Delicate silver key necklace for personal style on the neck slot. Appearance only.

item.name: Gold Bracelet
item.howToGet: Arm accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Gold bracelet style for the arm accessory slot. Fashion-only roll; no combat bonus.

item.name: Silver Clover Charm
item.howToGet: Arm accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Silver clover charm worn on the arm slot. Cosmetic wrist accessory from accessory rolls.

item.name: Watch
item.howToGet: Arm accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Classic watch-style arm accessory. Purely cosmetic; rolled on the arm slot.

item.name: Friendship Bracelet
item.howToGet: Arm accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Colorful friendship bracelet for the arm slot. Cosmetic collectible with no system effect.

item.name: Pink Tomodachi-Style Keychain
item.howToGet: Waist accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Bright pink friendship-style keychain charm for the waist slot. Cosmetic collectible only.

item.name: Silver Chain Keychain
item.howToGet: Waist accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Minimal silver chain keychain for the waist slot. Style detail with no combat use.

item.name: 8-Ball Car Keychain
item.howToGet: Waist accessory roll on the Stats menu
item.cardSummary: Black-and-white 8-ball car key charm for the waist slot. Cosmetic only.

item.name: Vending Machine Drinks
item.howToGet: Vending machines at Nishikata High School and city streets
item.cardSummary: Purchased drinks from school and street vending machines. Not part of accessory rolls. You can hold a drink while walking or sip it; machine stock can differ by location. Exact brand list and prices are not published.

item.name: Coffee Shop Coffee
item.howToGet: Nishikata Coffee Shop counter
item.cardSummary: Coffee bought at the Nishikata Coffee Shop counter—not from accessory rolls. Order at the counter for a holdable drink in a social hangout space. Full menu names and prices are not published.
